## The problem

Choose a fit allowance that lets two fabricated parts assemble as intended.

## Test and evidence

Record the designed size, measured size, tool settings, material, and observed fit. Include a photograph only when it is approved and does not identify a student.

## Revision

Explain the dimensional change and why the evidence supports it.
